t: The Magnusson organiser case provides efficient and secure storage for small fixings and components. This robust organiser is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general trade professionals requiring tidy organisation on site or in the workshop. Constructed from durable polypropylene, it offers water-resistant protection for contents. Its self-contained system features a hinged plastic lid for easy access, along with 18 compartments that include removable inserts, allowing for flexible customisation of storage layouts. A convenient carrying handle ensures easy transportation, and the unit supports a maximum load capacity of 4kg.
